p: Minshew is the quarterback for the Seattle game after Brissett was traded.
With Brissett gone and Minshew praised for sparking the offense, he is the clear QB for fantasy purposes.
Garner came in, gave us a great spark.
LaFleur praised his poise and work ethic after the Cowboys game, but he never explicitly named the starter or how the offense will change for him.
all he's done is be the guy that we expected.
Minshew replaced Brissett during the game, but LaFleur did not commit to him as the Week 9 starter.
He sparked the offense in the second half and is a live QB1 candidate, but LaFleur wouldn't confirm a starter.
